name: Change
source:
A first-year graduate Lulu wants to disappear.
Such Lulu was reminded of a classmate who died in middle school.

"I'd trade my life for yours."

This is the story of a protagonist who is tired of life and decides to switch bodies with a deceased classmate.
translation:
一年级毕业生露露想要消失。
这样的露露让露露想起了中学时去世的一位同学。

“我愿意用我的生命换取你的生命。”

这是一个主角厌倦了生活，决定与已故同学互换身体的故事。
